about: Franki's grammar points, read by Read & Listen's server (grammar.py, which gives each its finder) and bundled into the app (src/core/grammar.ts). docs/grammar.md has the fields and the rules.

points.name: Preterite
points.note: Finished past events: hablé, comió, fueron

points.name: Imperfect
points.note: Ongoing or habitual past: hablaba, comía, era

points.name: Present perfect
points.note: Has done: he hablado, ha comido

points.name: Pluperfect
points.note: Had done: había hablado, habían comido

points.name: Future
points.note: Will do: hablaré, tendrá, iremos

points.name: Conditional
points.note: Would do: hablaría, tendría, iríamos

points.name: Progressive
points.note: Be doing: estoy hablando, estaba comiendo

points.name: Present subjunctive
points.note: quiero que vengas, ojalá llueva

points.name: Imperfect subjunctive
points.note: si tuviera tiempo, quería que vinieras

points.name: เคย (have ever)
points.note: Experience: เคยไป, have been

points.name: กำลัง (in the middle of)
points.note: Ongoing: กำลังกิน, is eating

points.name: จะ (will)
points.note: Future or intention: จะไป, will go

points.name: แล้ว (already, now)
points.note: Done or changed: กินแล้ว, have eaten

points.name: ต้อง (must, have to)
points.note: Obligation: ต้องไป, have to go

points.name: กว่า (more than)
points.note: Comparing: แพงกว่า, more expensive

points.name: ที่สุด (the most)
points.note: Superlative: ดีที่สุด, the best

points.name: ถ้า (if)
points.note: Conditions: ถ้าฝนตก, if it rains

points.name: เพราะ (because)
points.note: Reasons: เพราะว่า, because

points.name: ไหม, หรือเปล่า (yes or no questions)
points.note: ไปไหม, are you going?

points.name: Perfect
points.note: Has done: ich habe gesagt, sie ist gegangen

points.name: Simple past
points.note: Did: ich war, er ging, wir machten

points.name: Pluperfect
points.note: Had done: ich hatte gesagt, sie war gegangen

points.name: Future
points.note: Will do: ich werde gehen, es wird regnen

points.name: Subjunctive II
points.note: Would, could: ich würde gehen, wenn ich Zeit hätte

points.name: Passive
points.note: Is done: das Haus wird gebaut, er wurde gefragt

points.name: Modal verbs
points.note: kann, muss, darf, soll, will, möchte + infinitive

points.name: Verb last after weil, dass, obwohl
points.note: Subordinate clauses: weil ich müde bin, dass er kommt

points.name: Passé composé
points.note: Did, has done: j'ai parlé, elle est partie

points.name: Imperfect
points.note: Was doing, used to: je parlais, il était

points.name: Future
points.note: Will do: je parlerai, il sera, nous irons

points.name: Near future
points.note: Going to: je vais partir, on va manger

points.name: Conditional
points.note: Would do: je parlerais, il serait, nous pourrions

points.name: Subjunctive
points.note: After que: il faut que je sois, qu'il fasse

points.name: Past tense
points.note: Did, was doing: он читал, она пошла

points.name: Future with буду
points.note: Will be doing: я буду читать, он будет работать

points.name: Conditional (бы)
points.note: Would: я бы пошёл, если бы знал

points.name: Imperative
points.note: Commands: читай, скажите, идите

points.name: Verbal adverbs
points.note: While or after doing: читая, прочитав, улыбаясь

points.name: Comparatives
points.note: Than: быстрее, лучше, более интересный

points.name: θα (will, would)
points.note: θα πάω, I'll go; θα ήθελα, I'd like

points.name: να (to, so that)
points.note: θέλω να πάω, πρέπει να φύγω

points.name: Past tense
points.note: Did, was doing: έγραψα, πήγαμε, ήταν

points.name: Perfect
points.note: Have done: έχω γράψει, έχει πάει

points.name: Pluperfect
points.note: Had done: είχα γράψει, είχαν φύγει

points.name: Past tense
points.note: Did: byłem, poszła, czytaliśmy

points.name: Future with będę
points.note: Will be doing: będę czytać, będzie padać

points.name: Conditional (by)
points.note: Would: chciałbym, gdyby

points.name: Questions with czy
points.note: Yes or no questions: czy masz czas?

points.name: Want, must, can + infinitive
points.note: chcę iść, muszę pracować, mogę pomóc

points.name: Past tense
points.note: Did: var, gikk, spiste, bodde

points.name: Present perfect
points.note: Has done: har vært, har spist

points.name: Past perfect
points.note: Had done: hadde vært, hadde spist

points.name: Future
points.note: skal reise, kommer til å regne

points.name: Passive
points.note: Is done: blir solgt, selges
